Name: (CP) nonkie's cotton candy critters
Author: nonkie
Description:
recolours ALL sprites in the critters.png to have a pastel, colourful palette inspired by PinkStations Cotton Candy Recolor.

[b]installation[/b]:
1. download and install the latest version of smapi.
2. download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]﻿.
3. ﻿unzip the mod folder(s) you want to use into your mod folder.
4. and done! your items will show in your game if there aren't any compatibility issues.
